cloze.sentence: Air ____ in major cities has reached levels that seriously threaten public health.
Many governments have introduced strict laws to reduce industrial ____.
The river was so contaminated that ____ killed almost all of the fish.
One of the main causes of ____ is the heavy reliance on private cars.
Noise ____ from the nearby airport makes it difficult for residents to sleep.
Switching to renewable energy could dramatically cut ____ from power stations.
Plastic ____ in the oceans harms marine life and eventually enters the food chain.
Factories should be fined heavily if they cause excessive ____.
Light ____ in urban areas prevents people from seeing the stars at night.
Educating children about ____ is the first step toward a cleaner environment.

translate.source: Ô nhiễm không khí là một trong những vấn đề nghiêm trọng nhất ở các thành phố lớn.
Chính phủ cần ban hành luật nghiêm khắc hơn để giảm ô nhiễm công nghiệp.
Ô nhiễm nguồn nước ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến sức khỏe của người dân.
Sự phụ thuộc vào xe cá nhân là nguyên nhân chính gây ra ô nhiễm.
Ô nhiễm nhựa đang đe dọa nghiêm trọng đến sinh vật biển.
Pollution from factories has damaged the surrounding farmland.
Reducing pollution requires cooperation between governments and citizens.
Traffic congestion is a major source of pollution in the capital.
Scientists warn that pollution is accelerating climate change.
The new policy aims to lower pollution levels by twenty percent.

scenario: In an IELTS essay arguing that governments should do more about the environment, write a formal sentence about pollution.
You are writing a complaint email to the city council about factory smoke near your home; use a polite but firm tone and mention pollution.
During a class debate, you support banning old vehicles; make a persuasive spoken point about pollution.
Write a caption for a school poster campaign warning classmates about pollution in an urgent tone.
In an academic report, describe one measurable effect of pollution using a neutral, factual tone.
You are chatting casually with a friend about why you dislike the traffic downtown; mention pollution informally.
Write a sentence for a formal presentation proposing a solution to reduce pollution.
In a letter to a newspaper editor, express concern about rising pollution in a serious, civic tone.
You are advising a younger student on essay vocabulary; explain in a simple sentence how pollution harms health.
Write a motivational message for a community clean-up event that mentions fighting pollution in an encouraging tone.

cloze.sentence: ____ is destroying the natural habitat of countless species.
Rapid ____ in the tropics contributes significantly to global warming.
The government banned logging in an attempt to slow down ____.
Large-scale ____ often leads to soil erosion and flooding.
Environmental groups are campaigning against the ____ of the rainforest.
One consequence of ____ is the loss of biodiversity.
Farmers clearing land for cattle are a major driver of ____.
Satellite images reveal the alarming rate of ____ over the past decade.
Reforestation projects aim to reverse the damage caused by ____.
Unless ____ is controlled, many indigenous communities will lose their homes.

translate.source: Nạn phá rừng đang phá hủy môi trường sống của nhiều loài động vật.
Phá rừng ở vùng nhiệt đới góp phần làm trái đất nóng lên.
Chính phủ đã cấm khai thác gỗ để ngăn chặn nạn phá rừng.
Phá rừng trên quy mô lớn thường dẫn đến xói mòn đất và lũ lụt.
Một hậu quả của nạn phá rừng là mất đa dạng sinh học.
Deforestation is one of the leading causes of species extinction.
The company was accused of causing deforestation to expand its plantations.
Stricter regulations are needed to prevent illegal deforestation.
Deforestation reduces the planet's capacity to absorb carbon dioxide.
Local activists have protested against deforestation for years.

scenario: In an IELTS Task 2 essay about the environment, write a formal sentence explaining a cause of deforestation.
You are giving an academic seminar; state one serious consequence of deforestation in a scholarly tone.
Write a persuasive slogan for an NGO poster opposing deforestation in an emotive tone.
In a formal letter to a government minister, urge action against deforestation in a respectful but insistent tone.
You are explaining to a curious younger sibling why forests matter; mention deforestation simply and warmly.
Write a neutral, factual sentence for a geography textbook describing where deforestation occurs most.
In a debate, argue that economic development does not justify deforestation using a firm tone.
Write a headline for an environmental news article about rising deforestation in a concise, serious tone.
You are drafting a proposal for a tree-planting project; mention reversing deforestation in an optimistic tone.
Post a short awareness message on social media condemning deforestation in an engaging, urgent tone.

cloze.sentence: Rising ____ has become a serious concern for the government.
Automation could lead to widespread ____ in the manufacturing sector.
High levels of ____ often result in increased crime rates.
The economic recession pushed ____ to a record high.
Youth ____ is particularly high in many developing countries.
Training programmes can help reduce long-term ____.
____ benefits provide temporary support for those who have lost their jobs.
The factory closure caused a sharp rise in local ____.
Governments try to lower ____ by encouraging foreign investment.
Prolonged ____ can have a damaging effect on people's mental health.

translate.source: Tình trạng thất nghiệp gia tăng đang là mối lo ngại lớn của chính phủ.
Tự động hóa có thể dẫn đến thất nghiệp trên diện rộng.
Tỷ lệ thất nghiệp cao thường dẫn đến gia tăng tội phạm.
Thất nghiệp ở giới trẻ đặc biệt cao ở nhiều nước đang phát triển.
Các chương trình đào tạo có thể giúp giảm thất nghiệp lâu dài.
Unemployment rose sharply during the financial crisis.
The government introduced new policies to tackle unemployment.
Long-term unemployment can lower a person's self-esteem.
Many economists worry that technology will increase unemployment.
Unemployment among graduates has become a growing problem.

scenario: In an IELTS essay about the effects of automation, write a formal sentence about unemployment.
You are presenting economic data at a conference; describe a trend in unemployment using an objective tone.
Write a sympathetic message to a friend who has just become unemployed in a caring, informal tone.
In a policy proposal to a city council, suggest a way to reduce unemployment in a formal tone.
During a job-fair speech, encourage young people facing unemployment in a motivating tone.
Write a neutral sentence for a news report stating the latest unemployment figures.
In a classroom debate, argue that education is the best solution to unemployment using a persuasive tone.
You are writing an academic essay conclusion; summarize the social effects of unemployment formally.
Draft a headline for a business newspaper about falling unemployment in a concise tone.
Explain to a beginner learner in a simple sentence what unemployment means and why it matters.

cloze.sentence: A generous ____ ensures that no citizen is left without basic support.
Critics argue that the ____ discourages people from finding work.
The ____ provides free healthcare and education to all residents.
Maintaining a ____ requires high levels of taxation.
Many Scandinavian countries are known for their strong ____.
Supporters believe the ____ reduces inequality across society.
The government has promised to protect the ____ despite budget cuts.
An aging population puts enormous pressure on the ____.
The concept of the ____ emerged in Europe after the Second World War.
Some economists claim the ____ is too expensive to sustain.

translate.source: Một nhà nước phúc lợi hào phóng đảm bảo không công dân nào bị bỏ rơi.
Nhiều người chỉ trích rằng nhà nước phúc lợi khiến người dân lười lao động.
Nhà nước phúc lợi cung cấp y tế và giáo dục miễn phí cho mọi người.
Duy trì một nhà nước phúc lợi đòi hỏi mức thuế cao.
Các nước Bắc Âu nổi tiếng với nhà nước phúc lợi vững mạnh.
The welfare state was designed to protect the most vulnerable citizens.
An aging population threatens the future of the welfare state.
Opponents claim the welfare state creates a culture of dependency.
The welfare state relies heavily on income from taxes.
A well-funded welfare state can significantly reduce poverty.

scenario: In an IELTS essay on inequality, write a formal sentence arguing in favour of a welfare state.
You are debating economics in class; argue against an expensive welfare state using a firm, reasoned tone.
In an academic essay, explain the historical origins of the welfare state in a scholarly tone.
Write a sentence for a formal policy brief warning that the welfare state is under financial strain.
You are chatting with a friend from Sweden about their country's welfare state in a curious, informal tone.
In a formal presentation, describe one benefit of a welfare state using a neutral, factual tone.
Write a persuasive opinion-column sentence defending the welfare state in an assertive tone.
During a university tutorial, ask a thoughtful question about how a welfare state is funded, politely.
Draft a balanced essay sentence acknowledging both a strength and a weakness of the welfare state.
Explain to an intermediate learner in a clear, simple sentence what a welfare state is.

cloze.sentence: Schools should do more to support students' ____.
Long working hours can have a serious impact on ____.
There is still a strong stigma attached to ____ problems in many societies.
Regular exercise is known to improve both physical and ____.
The pandemic caused a decline in the ____ of millions of people.
Employers are increasingly aware of the importance of ____ in the workplace.
Access to ____ services remains limited in rural areas.
Talking openly about ____ can help reduce feelings of isolation.
Social media has been linked to poor ____ among teenagers.
Good ____ is just as important as physical fitness.

translate.source: Nhà trường nên làm nhiều hơn để hỗ trợ sức khỏe tinh thần của học sinh.
Làm việc quá nhiều giờ có thể ảnh hưởng nghiêm trọng đến sức khỏe tinh thần.
Vẫn còn nhiều định kiến về các vấn đề sức khỏe tinh thần trong xã hội.
Tập thể dục thường xuyên giúp cải thiện sức khỏe tinh thần.
Mạng xã hội có liên quan đến sức khỏe tinh thần kém ở thanh thiếu niên.
Many companies now offer support programmes for mental health.
Poor mental health can affect a person's ability to work.
Raising awareness of mental health is essential in schools.
The government has increased funding for mental health services.
Good sleep plays an important role in maintaining mental health.

scenario: In an IELTS essay about modern lifestyles, write a formal sentence about the importance of mental health.
You are writing a supportive note to a stressed colleague; mention mental health in a warm, caring tone.
In an academic report, state one factor that affects mental health using a neutral, factual tone.
Write a sentence for a public-health campaign encouraging people to talk about mental health.
During a class discussion, argue that schools neglect mental health using a persuasive tone.
Write a formal email to a manager proposing a mental health day for staff in a professional tone.
You are advising a friend to see a counselor; mention mental health gently and informally.
Draft a headline for a wellness magazine article about mental health in a positive tone.
In an essay conclusion, summarize why mental health deserves more attention, formally.
Explain to a beginner learner in a simple sentence what mental health means.

cloze.sentence: Schools should place greater emphasis on developing ____ skills.
____ allows people to evaluate information rather than accept it blindly.
Employers increasingly value ____ over the ability to memorize facts.
Without ____, students may struggle to solve complex problems.
Reading widely can strengthen a person's ____.
The course is designed to encourage ____ and independent judgment.
____ is essential when assessing the reliability of online sources.
Many argue that traditional exams fail to test ____.
Debating helps young people sharpen their ____.
A good education should foster creativity as well as ____.

translate.source: Nhà trường nên chú trọng hơn vào việc phát triển tư duy phản biện.
Tư duy phản biện giúp con người đánh giá thông tin thay vì tin một cách mù quáng.
Nhà tuyển dụng ngày càng coi trọng tư duy phản biện.
Đọc sách nhiều có thể rèn luyện tư duy phản biện.
Tư duy phản biện rất cần thiết khi đánh giá các nguồn tin trên mạng.
Critical thinking helps students make better decisions.
The ability to apply critical thinking is highly valued in the workplace.
Many educators believe critical thinking should be taught from an early age.
Critical thinking enables us to question misleading advertisements.
Group discussions can encourage critical thinking among learners.

scenario: In an IELTS essay about education, write a formal sentence arguing that schools should teach critical thinking.
You are giving academic advice to a student; explain the value of critical thinking in a supportive tone.
In a job interview, describe how you use critical thinking at work in a confident, professional tone.
Write a persuasive debate point claiming that exams ignore critical thinking, in a firm tone.
In an academic essay, define critical thinking using a precise, scholarly tone.
Write an encouraging message to a study group about improving critical thinking together, informally.
Draft a sentence for a university brochure highlighting critical thinking as a course goal, in a formal tone.
During a class discussion, ask a thoughtful question about how critical thinking is developed, politely.
Write a neutral sentence for a report explaining why employers seek critical thinking.
Explain to an intermediate learner in a simple sentence what critical thinking means.

cloze.sentence: ____ is transforming the way businesses operate around the world.
Some experts warn that ____ could replace millions of jobs.
Hospitals are now using ____ to help diagnose diseases more accurately.
The rapid development of ____ raises important ethical questions.
Many smartphones rely on ____ to improve their cameras.
Governments are struggling to regulate ____ effectively.
____ can process enormous amounts of data in seconds.
Critics fear that ____ may be used to spread misinformation.
Schools are beginning to teach students about the basics of ____.
The benefits of ____ must be weighed against its potential risks.

translate.source: Trí tuệ nhân tạo đang thay đổi cách các doanh nghiệp hoạt động.
Một số chuyên gia cảnh báo trí tuệ nhân tạo có thể thay thế hàng triệu việc làm.
Các bệnh viện đang dùng trí tuệ nhân tạo để chẩn đoán bệnh chính xác hơn.
Sự phát triển nhanh của trí tuệ nhân tạo đặt ra nhiều câu hỏi đạo đức.
Các chính phủ đang gặp khó khăn trong việc quản lý trí tuệ nhân tạo.
Artificial intelligence can analyze data far faster than humans.
Many people worry that artificial intelligence will reduce job opportunities.
Artificial intelligence is already used in self-driving cars.
The rise of artificial intelligence demands new laws and regulations.
Artificial intelligence has the potential to improve healthcare significantly.

scenario: In an IELTS essay about technology, write a formal sentence about the benefits of artificial intelligence.
You are presenting at a tech conference; describe one impact of artificial intelligence in an objective tone.
Write a cautionary debate point about the risks of artificial intelligence in a serious tone.
In a job report, explain how artificial intelligence improves productivity, in a professional tone.
You are chatting with a friend about a new AI app; mention artificial intelligence casually.
Write a balanced essay sentence weighing the pros and cons of artificial intelligence, formally.
Draft a headline for a science magazine about artificial intelligence in a concise tone.
In a university lecture, define artificial intelligence for beginners using a clear, academic tone.
Write a persuasive sentence urging stricter regulation of artificial intelligence in an assertive tone.
Explain to an intermediate learner in a simple sentence what artificial intelligence is.

cloze.sentence: The campaign was launched to ____ of climate change.
Schools can ____ about the dangers of drug abuse.
Charities often use social media to ____ of their causes.
The documentary helped ____ of the plight of refugees.
Governments should do more to ____ of healthy eating.
The event aims to ____ about mental health issues.
Celebrities can use their fame to ____ of important social problems.
Volunteers went door to door to ____ of the recycling scheme.
Advertising campaigns are designed to ____ of road safety.
One effective way to ____ is through community workshops.

translate.source: Chiến dịch được phát động nhằm nâng cao nhận thức về biến đổi khí hậu.
Nhà trường có thể nâng cao nhận thức về tác hại của ma túy.
Các tổ chức từ thiện thường dùng mạng xã hội để nâng cao nhận thức.
Chính phủ nên làm nhiều hơn để nâng cao nhận thức về ăn uống lành mạnh.
Những người nổi tiếng có thể nâng cao nhận thức về các vấn đề xã hội.
The organization works hard to raise awareness of endangered species.
We must raise awareness of the risks of online scams.
The march was intended to raise awareness among young voters.
Educational programmes can raise awareness of environmental issues.
The poster campaign aims to raise awareness of water conservation.

scenario: In an IELTS essay about social problems, write a formal sentence about how governments can raise awareness.
You are drafting a proposal for a charity event; explain how it will raise awareness in a professional tone.
Write a motivating message rallying volunteers to help raise awareness in an enthusiastic tone.
In an academic essay, argue that education is the best way to raise awareness, formally.
Write a social-media caption for a campaign that aims to raise awareness in an engaging tone.
You are speaking to classmates about a school project to raise awareness; use a friendly, informal tone.
Draft a press-release sentence stating that an event will raise awareness, in a neutral tone.
In a formal letter to a sponsor, explain how their support will help raise awareness, respectfully.
Write a persuasive slogan encouraging people to raise awareness of recycling in a catchy tone.
Explain to an intermediate learner in a simple sentence what it means to raise awareness.
